info.name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace - FOOD
info.description: Food vertical: vendor auth, food catalog (categories/subcategories/products/addons) and food orders. Catalog taxonomy (categories/subcategories) and vendor account management are admin-only; products/addons are shared by Admin and Vendor.

item.name: Vendor Auth
item.description: Vendor login/session endpoints (mounted at /auth/vendor via auth.routes.ts).

item.name: Vendor Self-Service (Vendor App)
item.description: A vendor viewing/editing their own record via the Vendor App — GET/PATCH /vendors/:id also accept a VENDOR token, restricted to the caller's own vendor (see vendor.service.ts's assertVendorAccess). A vendor cannot reassign locationId or touch status/approvalStatus this way; those stay admin-only (see the Vendors (Admin) folder).

item.name: Admin Auth (for admin-gated endpoints)
item.description: Food-catalog management (categories, subcategories, vendors) is admin-only — log in here first to populate {{adminToken}}.
